templates.subject: Next step for your [JobTitle] application
templates.body:
Dear [CandidateName],

Thank you for sharing your experience with [CompanyName]. We would like to invite you to an interview for [JobTitle].

Our recruitment team will send the proposed time, meeting format and joining details separately. Please wait for those details before making travel arrangements. If you need an adjustment to take part comfortably, you may let the team know when confirming your availability.

We look forward to learning more about your work and answering your questions.

Kind regards,
[HRName]
[CompanyName]

templates.subject: Your [JobTitle] offer from [CompanyName]
templates.body:
Dear [CandidateName],

We are pleased to share the next step in your application for [JobTitle] at [CompanyName].

The hiring team will provide the formal offer with the role details, remuneration, proposed start date and response deadline. Please review that document carefully and contact the team if any information needs clarification. This notification does not replace the formal offer or confirm your acceptance.

Thank you for the time and care you have put into the recruitment process.

Kind regards,
[HRName]
[CompanyName]

templates.subject: Confirmation for your [JobTitle] application
templates.body:
Dear [CandidateName],

The recruitment team has recorded an accepted outcome for your application for [JobTitle] at [CompanyName].

Your designated contact will confirm any remaining documents and the next arrangements. Please follow the details in the formal offer and the team's subsequent instructions; this automated update does not introduce new employment terms.

Thank you for staying in touch throughout the process.

Kind regards,
[HRName]
[CompanyName]

templates.subject: An update on [JobTitle] at [CompanyName]
templates.body:
Dear [CandidateName],

Thank you for your interest in [JobTitle] at [CompanyName] and for the time you spent preparing your application.

After reviewing this recruitment round, we will not be progressing your application for this position. This decision relates to the requirements of the current vacancy and is not a judgement of your potential.

We appreciate the opportunity to learn about your experience and wish you well with your next application.

Kind regards,
[HRName]
[CompanyName]

templates.subject: We are reviewing your [JobTitle] application
templates.body:
Dear [CandidateName],

Your application for [JobTitle] at [CompanyName] is currently under review. The recruitment team is considering the information you submitted against the role requirements.

There is no additional action for you to take at this stage unless the team contacts you. We will share the next update when a decision is available; this message does not guarantee an interview or offer.

Thank you for your patience and your interest in joining us.

Kind regards,
[HRName]
[CompanyName]
